---
name: Device test report
about: Share results from running Libre on real devices
labels: device-test, measurement
---

**Test followed** (for example docs/DEVICE_TEST_BLE.md, docs/DEVICE_TEST_ANDROID.md, docs/DEVICE_TEST_BATTERY.md, or describe it)

**Date and time (with time zone)**

**Devices** (model, OS version, Libre commit)

**Radios** (Wi-Fi on or off, Bluetooth on, distance between devices)

**Results** (what worked, what failed, measured numbers with units)

**Logs** (attach `ble-log.txt` or Android log lines; device names and numbers only, never message text)

**Anything surprising**
